verdict: any one of the listed outcomes passes.
BROKE_JUDGED                 BROKE published after review: a judge disposition, not withheld, with a counterargument
WITHHELD_AFTER_REVIEW        NOT_DETERMINABLE, WITHHELD_PENDING_REVIEW, and the judge actually ran
direction: consistent | runs_counter | not_counted | any, or a list of them (any one passes). outcome (optional) also checks the row's outcome.
must_have: each bill must be in the evidence (not gated out, not below the floor) with the direction given.
direction: consistent | runs_counter | not_counted | any. outcome (optional) also checks the row's outcome.
any_of + min: at least `min` of the listed bills, each with the direction.
forbidden: bill_direction | { text } (must not appear on the card) | BROKE_WITHOUT_JUDGE | TALLY_ON_NOT_DETERMINABLE | TALLY_SHOWN | DID_NOTHING_WORDING.
band / count are checked only when a case sets them; flag_band reports without failing.
